authorityAndLimitations: All new capability remains RESEARCH_ONLY; no shipping provider registration or canonical scientific authority promotion was performed.
Hill AMD radial-overlap and short-horizon N-body diagnostics do not establish long-term resonance secular-chaos Lagrange or N-body stability.
The N-body diagnostic excludes collision physics general relativity tides and long-horizon validated integration.
Stellar and multiplicity evaluators require externally supplied exact versioned data; no empirical grid or table values were invented.
Distance-modulus and angular-geometry outputs are geometry/photometry transforms only and do not imply calibrated selection or detection probability.
Rocky mass-radius does not uniquely infer composition and is source-bounded to 1-8 Earth masses and CMF 0-0.4.
Water EOS density interpolation is not an interior integration or radius model and phase must come from versioned P-T phase data.
Sub-Neptune radius interpolation requires an exact Lopez-Fortney-family evolution grid and does not imply unique composition.
Reduced climate models do not assert weather GCM-equivalent local climate or habitability and require versioned parameter families before promotion.
Atmospheric escape remains regime/applicability gated and does not reconstruct universal atmospheric history.
Convection/geodynamics does not assert plate tectonics; critical Rayleigh viscosity thresholds Nu-Ra scaling and lag applicability are geometry/rheology/context dependent.
Stream-power erosion remains parameterized and cannot be treated as universal or calibrated exoplanet terrain history.
